query.statement: SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLANNED_QTY, PLANNED_START_DATE, PLANNED_END_DATE, STATUS, REMARK FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY PLANNED_START_DATE
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PLAN_ID = @planId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@lotState IS NULL OR LOT_STATE = @lotState) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId ORDER BY LOT_ID

SELECT LOT_HISTORY_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, TRACK_IN_TIME, TRACK_OUT_TIME, EXECUTION_ID, EXECUTION_USER, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, CREATED_AT FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND LOT_ID = @lotId ORDER BY LOT_HISTORY_ID

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@planId IS NULL OR PLAN_ID = @planId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotState IS NULL OR LOT_STATE = @lotState) AND (@isHold IS NULL OR IS_HOLD = @isHold) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, EQUIPMENT_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_HOLD = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, EQUIPMENT_ID FROM POM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DEFECT_QTY > 0 ORDER BY DEFECT_QTY DESC

SELECT PRODUCT_ID, COUNT(*) AS LOT_COUNT, SUM(QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(DEFECT_QTY) AS DEFECT_QTY, SUM(QTY) - SUM(DEFECT_QTY) AS GOOD_QTY FROM POM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC

SELECT WORK_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_NAME, PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WORK_ORDER_TYPE, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, START_QTY, COMPLETE_QTY, SCRAP_QTY, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM POM_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY PLAN_START_DATE DESC

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 존재 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). MERGE POM_WORK_ORDER AS t USING (SELECT @workOrderId AS WORK_ORDER_ID) AS s ON t.WORK_ORDER_ID = s.WORK_ORDER_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = @plantId, WORK_ORDER_NAME = @workOrderName, EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId, PRODUCT_ID = @productId, PLAN_QTY = @planQty, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (WORK_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_QTY, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@workOrderId, @plantId, @workOrderName, @equipmentId, @productId, @planQty, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);

SELECT TOP 500 LOT_HISTORY_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, TRACK_IN_TIME, TRACK_OUT_TIME, EXECUTION_ID, EXECUTION_USER, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY LOT_HISTORY_ID DESC
DELETE FROM POM_WORK_ORDER WHERE WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId
UPDATE POM_WORK_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Released', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId AND STATUS = 'Created'
UPDATE POM_WORK_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Cancelled', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId AND STATUS IN ('Created', 'Released')

SELECT P.PLANNED_ORDER_ID, P.RUN_ID, P.ITEM_ID, P.ORDER_TYPE, P.GROSS_QTY, P.ON_HAND_QTY, P.ON_ORDER_QTY, P.SAFETY_STOCK_QTY, P.NET_QTY, P.SUGGESTED_QTY, P.DUE_DATE, P.RELEASE_DATE, P.SOURCE_DEMAND, P.STATUS, P.PLANT_ID, P.CONVERTED_ORDER_ID FROM MRP_PLANNED_ORDER P WHERE P.RUN_ID = COALESCE(@runId, (SELECT R.RUN_ID FROM MRP_RUN R WHERE R.STARTED_AT = (SELECT MAX(R2.STARTED_AT) FROM MRP_RUN R2))) ORDER BY P.ORDER_TYPE, P.RELEASE_DATE, P.ITEM_ID

SELECT TOP 500 G.PLANNED_ORDER_ID, G.ITEM_ID, G.DEMAND_REF, G.QTY FROM MRP_PEGGING G WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE G.RUN_ID = COALESCE(@runId, (SELECT R.RUN_ID FROM MRP_RUN R WHERE R.STARTED_AT = (SELECT MAX(R2.STARTED_AT) FROM MRP_RUN R2))) ORDER BY G.PLANNED_ORDER_ID, G.PEGGING_ID

SELECT W.WORK_CENTER_ID, W.WORK_CENTER_NAME, W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN, COALESCE(SUM(P.SUGGESTED_QTY * S.STD_TIME_MIN), 0) AS LOAD_MIN, CASE WHEN W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(P.SUGGESTED_QTY * S.STD_TIME_MIN), 0) * 1.0 / W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN, 2) ELSE NULL END AS REQUIRED_DAYS FROM MDM_WORK_CENTER W WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN MDM_ROUTING_STEP S WITH (NOLOCK) ON S.WORK_CENTER_ID = W.WORK_CENTER_ID LEFT JOIN MDM_ROUTING R WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.ROUTING_ID = S.ROUTING_ID LEFT JOIN MRP_PLANNED_ORDER P WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.ITEM_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID AND P.ORDER_TYPE = 'Production' AND P.STATUS IN ('Proposed', 'Converted') AND P.RUN_ID = COALESCE(@runId, (SELECT R2.RUN_ID FROM MRP_RUN R2 WHERE R2.STARTED_AT = (SELECT MAX(R3.STARTED_AT) FROM MRP_RUN R3))) WHERE W.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' GROUP BY W.WORK_CENTER_ID, W.WORK_CENTER_NAME, W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN ORDER BY LOAD_MIN DESC
SELECT RUN_ID, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, STATUS, DEMAND_COUNT, PLANNED_ORDER_COUNT, MESSAGE, EXECUTED_BY FROM MRP_RUN ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC
